name: Cheng Qiyan
source:
Identity: Local Wizard
Occupation: A local guide with a wealth of experience with tourists at the inn. Also responsible for the logistics work.
Character: Sincere and welcoming. His warmth towards you is directly proportional to how much you buy from him. He also enjoys being a spoilsport.
Talents: He thinks he is a great poet and often writes poetry when inspired by the things around him. (His poems are not that great, though.) 
Dream: so that children can amount to anything.
Experience: 5 years experience as a guide.
Why he is here: As a guide.
Quote: "I know at least ten versions of the legend of the mountain. I even know who made them up, at which village. Do you not want to know?"
